methods.name: Rule-derived decision lanes
methods.description: Lane candidates derive from canonical material facts through controlled predicates rather than copied candidate lists.
limitations: Every candidate still requires product, equipment, geometry, and exposure verification.

methods.name: Family-level material guidance
methods.description: Qualitative family guidance supports comparison and screening, but exact filament formulations differ.
limitations: Check the exact product TDS and SDS.
Test a representative printed part before engineering use.

methods.name: Qualitative property ratings
methods.description: Controlled ratings summarize practical tendencies and are not standardized material-property measurements.
limitations: Geometry, moisture, orientation, processing, and formulation can change behavior.

methods.name: Relative cost tier
methods.description: Cost tiers are market-position heuristics for consumable filament.
limitations: They are not live prices or total printed-part costs.

methods.name: Transparent selector scoring
methods.description: The primary goal contributes two preference matches and each applicable secondary preference contributes one after hard constraints.
limitations: The score describes alignment, not universal material quality, strength, safety, or superiority.

methods.name: Practical service-temperature guidance
methods.description: Service ranges are modest-load selection guidance and remain separate from named thermal tests.
limitations: They are not guaranteed limits, certifications, or substitutes for product qualification.

methods.name: Starting-profile limits
methods.description: Temperatures, speeds, and fan values are conservative calibration starting points, not maxima or guarantees.
limitations: Tune for the exact filament, printer, nozzle, geometry, layer height, flow, chamber, and moisture state.

methods.name: Named thermal metric identity
methods.description: Tg, HDT, Vicat, melting point, and service guidance answer different questions and are not interchangeable.
limitations: Compare only matching test methods, loads, conditioning, and annealing states.

processGates.label: Drying and dry-storage capability
processGates.requirement: Provide active drying and dry storage when the material requires it.
processGates.verification: Follow exact product drying limits and confirm a dry process path.

processGates.label: Enclosure capability
processGates.requirement: Provide the enclosure or chamber capability required by the material.
processGates.verification: Confirm enclosure temperature capability, thermal stability, and printer approval.

processGates.label: Flexible-material feed path
processGates.requirement: Use a constrained feed path suitable for flexible filament.
processGates.verification: Confirm extrusion stability with the exact hardness and speed.

processGates.label: Wear-resistant nozzle capability
processGates.requirement: Use wear-resistant extrusion hardware when the material requires it.
processGates.verification: Confirm nozzle and feed-path compatibility with the exact filler.

processGates.label: Industrial process hardware
processGates.requirement: Use qualified high-temperature hardware and process controls.
processGates.verification: Confirm hotend, bed, heated chamber, drying, and ventilation capability.

processGates.label: Soluble-support process
processGates.requirement: Control storage, pairing, removal, and disposal for soluble support materials.
processGates.verification: Verify main-material compatibility and follow solvent or water-handling guidance.

processGates.label: Temperature capability
processGates.requirement: Use hotend, bed, and chamber hardware rated for the selected starting range.
processGates.verification: Confirm component ratings and printer manufacturer limits.

processGates.label: Ventilation capability
processGates.requirement: Provide the relative ventilation control category required by the process.
processGates.verification: Read the exact SDS and confirm applicable enclosure and workplace controls.

decisionLanes.label: Chemical exposure
verification: Verify chemical, concentration, temperature, contact time, and stress state.

decisionLanes.label: Decorative fills
verification: Fillers can be abrasive; the base polymer governs heat and creep. Control finishing dust.

decisionLanes.label: Easy prototypes
decisionLanes.need: Start quickly with a lower-burden material.
verification: Check heat, creep, and impact limits before treating a prototype material as a service material.

decisionLanes.label: High heat and sustained load
decisionLanes.need: Select for elevated temperature and sustained load.
verification: Thermal metrics are not equivalent; verify test, load, duration, orientation, and conditioning.

decisionLanes.label: Impact and flex
decisionLanes.need: Select for impact, flex, or repeated movement.
verification: Orientation, strain, wall geometry, and cycle count can dominate the family rating.

decisionLanes.label: Industrial
verification: Confirm hotend, bed, chamber, drying, ventilation, and exact-grade process window.

decisionLanes.label: Outdoor
decisionLanes.need: Select for outdoor and UV exposure.
verification: Verify pigment, formulation, water ingress, temperature cycling, and exposure duration.

decisionLanes.label: Support materials
verification: Match support to the main-material temperature and follow moisture and removal safety guidance.
